countries.title: Countries
countries.description: 2 letter country codes, one per line (US, GB, DE, KE, IN...). 187 countries are covered.

startYear.title: From year
startYear.description: First year to fetch. Future years work: holiday dates are computed from each country's rules.

endYear.title: To year

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
